title: CI had not run for 46 days: two stacked breakages, the second hiding the first
detail: Verified by the controller over all 554 runs: 529 failure, 23 success, last success 2026-07-22T22:53:02Z. Green on run 34053229048 with all six corpus guards naming themselves (6 verified, 0 skipped) and 2647 tests passed.

title: A second video-port write in one instruction re-charges the first write's stall, 40 percent over-billed
detail: now_mclk is set once per instruction while fifo_slot_clock is absolute. Six stalling writes charge 967 cycles against a true 281. data_read_at does it correctly one function away. Every existing test stops at the fifth write.

title: The Z80 reset line is a hold, not a reset: a halted sound driver never restarts
detail: Measured with two controls. Z80 exposes no reset method; the core is constructed once and never re-initialised. The rule was written into docs/2026-07-22-sound-stack-recon.md:224 in July with 'pin it, do not let it drift' and never implemented.

title: About 560 real Z80 encodings panic uncontained; one byte in a guest driver kills the process
detail: Measured by executing every prefixed encoding under catch_unwind: ED 20, DD 46, FD 46, DDCB 224, FDCB 224. No catch_unwind anywhere in production. A commercial ROM reached this class before.

title: Every replay frame renders a full attributed scanline and discards it, to produce three status bits
detail: wants_scanlines defaults to false and oracle-replay's Fanout overrides neither. The tool whose pitch is one playthrough instead of many pays a discarded raster every frame.

title: Three guard tests and the guards they test both vanish under --release
detail: Controller re-measured: 11 tests in debug, 8 in release. They do not report as ignored; the count drops silently.

title: A reset could strand or roll back the owner's battery save
detail: Not hosted-only, so the booked mitigation did not cover it. The existing guard asserted on the machine and never the file, and its helper never ran the debounce. Fixed structurally in Bus::call_stamped; two new rows read the real .srm and each goes red naming the file.

title: The request side of the wire has a machine-readable contract and no differential against it
detail: 57 integer bounds in the fragments; jsonschema is a dev-dependency only; every bound re-implemented by hand in 62 handlers. 21 of 62 methods have no negative-value test. One Engine on one thread with no catch_unwind.

title: The listing-freshness guard is blind to two of the three populations it gates
detail: Compares address rows only; equates and phase are disjoint populations, and lookup_equate attaches this very caveat. Change an equate's value and the server answers the old number quietly. Zero equate coverage in the freshness suite.

title: The most-repeated safety claim in the tree names a mechanism that does not exist
detail: Repeated in eight source comments, two escalating to 'none may ever be added'. No compile-fail harness exists in the workspace and no test asserts the signature. A correct example naming a real mechanism sits 4000 lines away in the same crate.

title: The drift gate landed this morning covers none of the eleven symbols the panel landed this afternoon needs
detail: Controller re-measured: 25 rows, zero matching Parallax|Raster|BgAnim, against a working control. Controller correction: the FIXTURES are the stale side, not the panel.

title: A per-line scroll value is fetched once per pixel, 320 times more often than it can change
detail: plane_hscroll takes no x and does two VRAM reads. The line-hoisted copy already sits in ASlotCtx three lines away. Confirmed in the shipped binary by objdump.

title: A damaged-but-binding symbol file is disclosed on three surfaces and silent on the two that answer programs
detail: Load a truncated listing in the window and you get a warning; load the same file over the socket and it is accepted silently. Names then resolve to a plausible, healthy-looking, wrong routine.

title: The completed-frame reader exists four times and only the copy scheduled for deletion is tested
detail: The retirement deletes the only tested copy and leaves two untested, one of which backs emulator/screenshot and every hosted client.

title: A doc says callers must not reach this arm and the sole caller does
detail: Space::Z80 is a live selector entry. The covering test picks Space::Vram and asserts a message the Z80 path fails.

title: The I/O decode rule is applied on the read path and contradicted on the write path
detail: Read cites its evidence; write states the opposite rule citing nothing. Word writes are unaffected, which is why no golden catches it. The seat reported the contradiction and refused to adjudicate the hardware question.

title: A bounded list bypasses the blessed helper its sibling uses on the identical bound
detail: No total, no returned, no limit, where the helper's own doc makes all three the rule and the schema makes them required. The fragment was transcribed to the hand-rolled shape, so conformance is structurally blind.

title: Nothing in the sweep was exercised against a running emulator, window, or full suite
detail: Charter rules 2 to 4, with the owner's window live throughout. Every runtime-dependent claim is tagged rather than asserted.

title: The 20-agent cap degraded three seats that ran, not only the five it delayed
detail: A2, ERR and P2 each had helper agents refused and pattern-swept engine.rs and ui.rs rather than reading them. All three disclosed it unprompted. Coverage is narrower than 22 seats implies.

title: F-THREE-MASKED-RENDERERS is not a live drift risk: both divergences are unreachable
detail: The three copies differ in two guards, but both depend on a short or empty row and resolve_line_masked sets width unconditionally, including on the display-disabled early return. Dead code. What survives is the missing assertion.

title: The audio-repair door-that-runs-no-repair lead is refuted
detail: Every machine-replacing door runs it, structurally, in both windows. The bus-notification half of the same lead was confirmed and is a separate finding.

title: land.sh G1 is not the only thing between a fresh worktree and a false green
detail: G1 only counts files; the real backstop is six in-suite refusals armed by CI=1 that check named manifests. Residual: a human typing the raw cargo command gets CI unset and every corpus row skips invisibly.

title: PIN.tsv is not restated anywhere in code
detail: No sha, byte count or freeze revision from the pin is hardcoded in Rust or tools. The pin is read, never restated.

title: 576 test functions added over 250 commits, 11 removed, zero silent deletions
detail: Six were renamed because the behaviour changed. No guard was deleted and left claimed as live in code.

title: Layer and LayerMask cannot gain a variant without declaring it everywhere
detail: ALL is test-guarded, every match exhaustive with no catch-all, and targets() derives the wire names with a test pinning the derivation against the vendored fragment in both directions.

title: DIMENSIONS.tsv is derived and re-verified every run, not transcribed
detail: Re-measured through SymbolTable against independently pinned bytes, with a positive control that panics on an uncovered probe kind.

title: Symbol resolution is a binary search over a pre-sorted index and the Arc clones are refcount bumps
detail: Expected to find a linear scan and did not.

title: The SAT cache's two-copies-of-one-truth is correct by design
detail: The staleness being modelled is the hardware's own, so recomputation would be the wrong answer. Documented with its reason and guarded by a test.

title: Around twenty idiom candidates checked and cleared as deliberate, each with its reason in place
detail: Includes a hand-formatted address whose sum can exceed u32 and five of six debug asserts carrying a stated reason, one naming the test that would actually catch it.

title: The Z80 reset line is a hold, not a reset: a halted sound driver never restarts
detail: Fixed. Z80::reset clears PC, I, R, IFF1, IFF2, IM and halted, and preserves the register file, index registers and SP; fires on the asserting edge only. Eleven mutations, each red on the row under test, including the silent-forever case. End-to-end test drives the real bus and observes EXECUTION, not a register or a latch. singlestep_z80 708,000 cases, 0 failures. The deferral that licensed this stated its own expiry condition in July and nobody returned; that doc now carries the pin.

title: The drift gate landed this morning covers none of the eleven symbols the panel landed this afternoon needs
detail: Fixed. Manifest 25 rows to 85; the control that read 0 now reads 65. Twelve dimensions pinned across four listings, including three pinned as ABSENT so a symbol becoming present also reddens. Gate deliberately left GREEN: the agent argued, correctly, that writing the engine's current addresses into a column the manifest binds to the frozen bytes would convert a recovery gate into a permanently-red currency gate and force the open owner decision rather than leave it open.

title: About 560 real Z80 encodings panic uncontained; one byte in a guest driver kills the emulator
detail: Closed by SERVING all 560, not by containing them. Stage 1 made refusal structural (a fault latch checked ahead of interrupt acceptance and the HALT idle; deliberately NOT halted=true, which is architectural state an interrupt would wake, vectoring into the program the core just refused). Stage 2 implemented every class graded against the vendored SingleStepTests corpus at pin ebe1875d: ED mirrors 20/20, IXH/IXL 92/92, DDCB/FDCB register-copy 448/448, 1000 cases per encoding, green on the first run; whole z80 suite 1268 files / 1,268,000 cases. New gate crates/oracle-core/tests/z80_guest_bytes_never_panic.rs steps all 1524 complete encodings plus 4096 two-prefix chains under catch_unwind: 0 panicked, 1524 executed, 0 refused. The deferral's stated reason was itself the defect: the in-tree comment said a documented-mode corpus never fetches them, true of our FILES list and false of the corpus, where all 560 answer keys existed at the pinned SHA (560 HEAD probes, 404 detector control). Controller verified with a mutation in a class the agent did not touch: forcing LD IXL,n to write IXH reddens the corpus run naming IX [DD 2E 0000] while unprefixed 2e.json still passes 1000/1000. Manifest checked as a set: 560 added, 0 of 708 removed; 1268/1268 sha256 OK. Landed GREEN 80/80 legs. Residual: Z80::refuse now has zero callers because exhaustive matches serve everything, kept deliberately with the reason at the definition. TAGGED, needs foreground: a real driver using IXH/IXL playing audibly; and a CR for a typed z80Fault key, since today it is a conditional caveat and the contract forbids parsing caveats.

title: Three guard tests and the guards they test both vanish under --release
detail: debug_assert! guards promoted to assert! in the fixture builder, plus three sibling guards of the same class in the same file. Controller measured both profiles independently, before and after: testrom:: scope was 11 tests in debug and 8 in release (dropping silently, not reporting as ignored), and is 11/11 after. oracle-core 1129 passed 0 failed in BOTH profiles. No pin was added and none is possible: once the guard is a plain assert! the profile split does not exist, and the three de-gated #[should_panic] rows ARE the regression guard, so fix and guard are one edit. Proven by demoting a guard back to debug_assert!, which reddens two rows under --release rather than deleting them (9 passed 2 failed = 11). Swept: no #[cfg(debug_assertions)] remains on any test row in crates/.

title: schema_conformance.rs's loud refusal is silent: libtest eats the SKIPPED banner
detail: ADDED TO THE LEDGER AS FIXED: this packet HIGH had no ledger row while it was open, so it never appeared in an open tally. Recorded now so the fixed record is true; it does not change any open count. The house fd-2 helper from c301f89 applied to the file that c301f89's own follower (mcp_tool_sweep.rs) names as its exemplar, which the original sweep had missed. Controller verified both directions firsthand: on main a plain cargo test prints nothing at all; at the fix the same command prints the 13-line SKIPPED banner. Worse than elsewhere because no runner sets $AETHER_CONTRACT_SCHEMA or $AETHER_CONTRACT_REPO, so the skip branch is the one every landing takes. Residual, NOT closed by this: nothing has still ever confirmed the pinned contract revision exists upstream. H5 made the refusal audible; it did not make the confirmation happen.
